body:
# Wendy Padilla

# Vice-Chair

![](/media/uploads/2026/02/padilla-profile.png)

- In a campaign interview she said she **[believes in](https://indyweek.com/news/orange-county-schools-board-of-education-wendy-padilla/)** diversity, equity, and inclusion.
- Padilla **[said](https://indyweek.com/news/orange-county-schools-board-of-education-wendy-padilla/)**, “we need to continue to dismantle racism particularly when it comes to gender identity.”
- Padilla **[said](https://indyweek.com/news/orange-county-schools-board-of-education-wendy-padilla/)** she has “an issue with the Parent Bill of Rights.” She claims students and staff should not have to struggle to be themselves.
- Padilla **[claims](https://indyweek.com/news/orange-county-schools-board-of-education-wendy-padilla/)** school resource officers (police) have negatively impacted “some students of color.”
